categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Changhong Technology Co., Ltd. operates primarily in four segments: medical devices and high polymer plastic consumables, intelligent manufacturing products, semiconductor consumables, and precision molds. The company provides integrated one-stop solutions including product design, precision mold manufacturing, automation integration, and diversified injection molding. Its medical segment covers gene sequencing consumables, life science laboratory consumables, assisted reproduction consumables, in vitro diagnostics, specimen collection and processing systems, and blood dialysis consumables. Intelligent manufacturing products serve smart office equipment, smart home, smart medical, smart logistics, automotive manufacturing, smart education, and electronic components. Semiconductor consumables include wafer carriers and clean packaging materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced precision mold design and manufacturing, customized automation production lines, and sophisticated injection molding technologies including micro-precision, ultra-precision molding, two-color injection molding, and thin-wall high-pressure molding. It employs CAD/CAE/CAM/CAPP/PDM/ERP software integration for digital intelligent manufacturing. Production facilities include GMP-compliant cleanrooms certified to ISO 14644 standards for medical consumables and high-cleanliness environments for semiconductor plastic consumables. The company emphasizes R&D in precision molds, automated production integration, and injection molding process optimization, supported by provincial and Shanghai-based engineering research centers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves global leading customers in medical diagnostics, including Roche Diagnostics, and has established supply chains with 19 internationally renowned medical customers. Its intelligent manufacturing clients include manufacturers of printers, copiers, tablets, smart speakers, and logistics robots. Semiconductor consumables customers are mainstream wafer fabs in China. The company’s products are used in gene sequencing, life sciences, assisted reproduction, in vitro diagnostics, blood glucose monitoring, insulin pumps, microfluidics, minimally invasive surgical robots, and semiconductor wafer handling.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and production bases are located in Shenzhen, Heyuan, Zhejiang, Shanghai, Vietnam, and the Philippines, covering South China, East China, and Southeast Asia. The company has established a European marketing center in Switzerland to manage European markets. Overseas subsidiaries operate with local currency accounting in Vietnam (Vietnamese Dong), the Philippines (Philippine Peso), and Switzerland (Swiss Franc). The company’s sales are predominantly international, with 75.35% of revenue generated from overseas markets including North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
categories.supply_chain_position: Changhong Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It designs and manufactures precision molds and injection-molded components, integrates automated production lines, and produces finished consumables and devices for medical, intelligent manufacturing, and semiconductor industries. It acts as an ODM and OEM supplier, providing customized products and integrated manufacturing solutions to brand owners and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on technological innovation and high-end manufacturing. It prioritizes R&D in precision mold technology, automated intelligent production integration, and advanced injection molding processes. Key R&D projects include precision molds for blood glucose meters, multi-cavity molds for diagnostic consumables, coagulation reaction cups, molecular diagnostic consumables, and semiconductor wafer carrier molds. The company aims to enhance core technologies, expand product portfolios in medical, intelligent manufacturing, and semiconductor sectors, and accelerate internationalization and digital transformation through PLM and smart factory systems.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of physical products including precision molds, medical consumables, intelligent manufacturing components, and semiconductor consumables. The company mainly uses a direct sales model, with a small portion through distributors. It provides customized ODM and OEM manufacturing services, generating income from product design, mold development, automated production integration, and component sales. The company also earns investment income and government subsidies as non-operating income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading high-tech enterprise in precision molds, medical consumables, intelligent manufacturing, and semiconductor consumables in China. It competes with multinational corporations in high-value medical devices and consumables but benefits from national policies favoring domestic innovation and localization. Its competitive advantages include integrated one-stop solutions, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and strong R&D. It has established strategic partnerships with global medical giants like Roche, enhancing its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.039 billion, an 11.56% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 101.96 million, a 222.11% increase. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.46 billion with net assets of RMB 1.63 billion. It maintains a stable growth trajectory with expanding overseas sales (75.35% of revenue) and continuous investment in production capacity and R&D. The company’s gross margin improved in medical consumables and intelligent manufacturing segments, supporting profitability growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Changhong Technology emphasizes its integrated one-stop solution capability combining precision mold design, customized automation production, and high-quality injection molding processes. It offers high-precision, high-stability products meeting stringent international standards (GMP, ISO 13485, FDA). The company’s ability to rapidly respond to diverse customer needs with customized solutions and its advanced cleanroom manufacturing environment differentiate it in medical and semiconductor consumables markets. Its strong R&D and innovation pipeline, coupled with global supply chain and service capabilities, provide customers with reliable, high-performance products and services.
